failure_summary.description: The agent imported tools from a nonexistent module instead of calling injected functions directly.
The agent omitted result persistence or failed to apply outstanding criteria to compatible cached results.
The agent missed information already supplied, treated an explicit ideal date as missing, or represented a return leg incorrectly.
The agent stopped with “No planning needed” or skipped the requested proximity operation despite new work remaining.

patch.reasoning: The observed failures are already directly covered by the skill: it forbids imports, requires saving search and transformation results, directs agents to use compatible cached results for new criteria, and explains date and round-trip handling. Rewording these rules would duplicate existing guidance rather than patch a documentation gap.
